gameRules.name: Pond
gameRules.goal: Guide the koi to each glowing bud until every lotus opens.
gameRules.howToPlay: Touch or drag anywhere on the water and the koi will swim toward your finger. Lift your finger to let it wander.
gameRules.tip: There is no timer or score. Tap Ripple anytime to stir the water.

gameRules.name: Hue
gameRules.goal: Arrange the colour tiles so every row and column blends smoothly from corner to corner.
gameRules.howToPlay: Tap two tiles to swap them, or drag one onto another. Tiles with a small diamond dot are locked in place.
gameRules.tip: Start near the locked tiles and work inward. Tap Hint to light up one helpful swap.

gameRules.name: Thread
gameRules.goal: Connect every matching pair of shapes with a line and cover every square on the board.
gameRules.howToPlay: Drag from a shape to its match. Lines cannot cross, so drawing over another line cuts it back.
gameRules.tip: Every square must be used. If empty squares remain, take a longer route with one of your lines.

gameRules.name: Drift
gameRules.goal: Put the numbered tiles in order from 1, starting at the top left, with the empty space at the bottom right.
gameRules.howToPlay: Tap any tile in the same row or column as the empty space to slide it over, or swipe the board.
gameRules.tip: A small gold dot marks tiles in the right spot. Solve the top row first, then work down.

gameRules.name: Nine
gameRules.goal: Fill the grid so every row, column, and 3x3 box holds the numbers 1 to 9 with no repeats.
gameRules.howToPlay: Tap an empty square, then tap a number below. Turn on Notes to jot down possible numbers inside a square.
gameRules.tip: Notes clear themselves as soon as you place a matching number in the same row, column, or box.

gameRules.name: Weave
gameRules.goal: Fill the right squares to uncover a hidden picture.
gameRules.howToPlay: Side numbers show groups of filled squares in order (2 1 means two filled, a gap, then one). Drag to fill, or Mark empties.
gameRules.tip: Start with the biggest numbers first, since they leave the fewest choices. Tap Hint if a row feels stuck.

gameRules.name: Dim
gameRules.goal: Turn off every lit square until the whole board is dark.
gameRules.howToPlay: Tap any square to flip its light, along with the squares directly above, below, left, and right of it.
gameRules.tip: Tapping a dark square can still help by flipping its lit neighbours. Tap Hint to highlight one helpful move.

gameRules.name: Lanterns
gameRules.goal: Find every matching pair of hidden symbols on the board.
gameRules.howToPlay: Tap two tiles to flip them over. Matching pairs stay open; two different tiles flip back after a moment.
gameRules.tip: You do not have to wait for a mismatch to close. Just tap your next tile right away.

gameRules.name: Settle
gameRules.goal: Stack the falling blocks to make full horizontal rows so they clear away.
gameRules.howToPlay: Tap the board to rotate, drag sideways to move, swipe down to drop, and swipe up to hold. Or use the buttons.
gameRules.tip: In Endless mode, if the stack reaches the top, the bottom four rows clear away so you can keep playing.

gameRules.name: Ember
gameRules.goal: Combine matching numbers to build higher tiles and reach 2048.
gameRules.howToPlay: Swipe up, down, left, or right to slide all tiles at once. Matching tiles that touch merge into double their number.
gameRules.tip: Keep your biggest number in one corner. If the board fills up, tap Undo or Make room to clear two small tiles.

gameRules.name: Cascade
gameRules.goal: Clear groups of matching stones from the board.
gameRules.howToPlay: Tap any group of two or more touching stones of the same colour to drop them away. Bigger groups score more points.
gameRules.tip: Leave one colour alone while you clear others around it, so it gathers into one big group.

gameRules.name: Chime
gameRules.goal: Bounce the ball off your paddle to break every block in the wall.
gameRules.howToPlay: Tap to launch the ball, then drag the bar below to move your paddle. Hitting near an edge changes the angle.
gameRules.tip: Blocks with a gold border take two hits. If you miss the ball, it simply comes back to your paddle.

gameRules.name: Rally
gameRules.goal: Keep the ball bouncing back and forth across the court as long as you can.
gameRules.howToPlay: Drag the bar below the court to move your paddle. Hit the ball near an edge to send it at a sharper angle.
gameRules.tip: As bedtime gets closer, the ball slows down and your paddle grows a little wider.
